facts.fact: 信末署名 Yumi，写信人是她
她说自己当这个街区 Facebook 群的管理员已经五年
facts.anchor: moderating the Eastbrook neighborhood Facebook group for the past five years

facts.fact: 她仍持有一张照片：Autumn 中枪那晚，收信人从父母租的房子里出来
facts.anchor: I am still in possession of the photograph I have of you leaving your parents’ rental the night Autumn was shot

facts.fact: 照片里枪和 Autumn 的笔记本电脑都看得见
facts.anchor: The gun and Autumn’s laptop are both visible

facts.fact: 收信人的父母两人现在都在监狱里
她要收信人继续按季度往那个账户付款
facts.anchor: keeping up the quarterly payments to the account

facts.fact: 照片和一份详细陈述存在云端，她或她儿子一旦出事就送交警方
facts.anchor: are stored in the cloud and will be delivered to the police should anything happen to me or my son

facts.fact: 收信人和她哥哥在 Stanford
facts.anchor: Hope you and your brother are enjoying Stanford
